title: Closed models [notes postérieures à PS ?] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting: A, B small categories, ^ denotes presheaves, (A×B)^ = Hom((A×B)°, Ens). This is a technical lemma page. The next page computes X^{Δ_n}, p_{B*}Hom(p_A^*Δ_n, X), (Cosk_{n-1}X)_n and lifting maps X_n → (X^{∂Δ_n})_0 ×_{(Y^{∂Δ_n})_0} Y_n. So the context is a closed-model / Reedy-type analysis of presheaves on a product A×B, e.g. simplicial objects of B^ with A = Δ.

(1) Universal-property chain. Presheaves on A×B ≃ functors A°→B^ ≃ functors (A^)°→B^ that send colimits of A^ to limits (the '!' extension). Symmetrically in B. Finally ≃ functors (A^)°×(B^)°→Ens sending colimits to limits in each variable separately ('!!'). Up to that point everything is correct: A^ is the free cocompletion of A.

In the margin he adds that '!!' 'signifie le même que le signe ! relatif à (A^×B^)°', i.e. that separate continuity equals joint continuity on the product category. This is false. A jointly continuous F satisfies F(L,M) = F(L,∅)×F(∅,M), since (L,M) = (L,∅)⊔(∅,M) in A^×B^. Such functors correspond to presheaves on A⊔B, not on A×B. The right notion for A×B is the 'bilinear' one: (A×B)^ is the tensor product of the cocomplete categories A^ and B^.

(2) For X in (A×B)^ the corresponding separately continuous functor is X(L,M) = Hom(L⊠M, X), where L⊠M = pr_A^*L × pr_B^*M. This is correct, since ⊠ is cocontinuous in each variable and agrees with the Yoneda functor on representables: a⊠b = h_{(a,b)}.

(3) 'Proposition': (L,M) ↦ L⊠M is fully faithful, i.e. Hom(L'⊠M', L⊠M) = Hom(L',L)×Hom(M',M). Proof given: both sides agree for L'=a, M'=b representable, and both 'transform colimits into limits' in (L',M').

(4) 'Corollaire': internal Hom(L'⊠M', L⊠M) ≃ Hom(L',L)⊠Hom(M',M). Proof: test against a⊠b. Use (a⊠b)×(L'⊠M') = (a×L')⊠(b×M') (correct), then the Proposition, then adjunction. He writes 'ok'.

Correct general formula: Hom(L'⊠M', L⊠M) ≃ Hom(L'×π0(M'), L) × Hom(π0(L')×M', M), where π0 = colim, viewed as a constant presheaf. The internal-Hom analogue is similar. The Proposition holds e.g. when L' and M' are connected (colim = point), in particular when one factor is the terminal presheaf. That case (… ⊠ e_B) is what the next page actually uses, so the downstream application may survive.
errors: The marginal claim that '!!' (cocontinuity separately in each variable) means the same as '!' relative to (A^×B^)° (joint cocontinuity on the product category) is false. Jointly continuous functors (A^×B^)°→Ens correspond to presheaves on A⊔B, not A×B.

The Proposition is false in general. Counterexample with A=B=pt (so A^=Ens): Hom(L'×M', L×M) ≠ Hom(L',L)×Hom(M',M); for all four sets of size 2, 256 ≠ 16. The functor ⊠ is not full. It also fails at empty presheaves: if L'=∅, the LHS is a singleton but the RHS is Hom(M',M).

The gap in the proof: the LHS Hom(L'⊠M', L⊠M) turns colimits into limits only separately in L' and M'. The RHS Hom(L',L)×Hom(M',M) turns colimits into limits jointly, and is not separately continuous: for fixed M', a coproduct in L' duplicates the factor Hom(M',M). Agreement on pairs of representables therefore does not propagate. This is the same conflation as in the margin remark.
Consequently the Corollary Hom(L'⊠M', L⊠M) ≃ Hom(L',L)⊠Hom(M',M) is false in general. For sets, (L×M)^{L'×M'} ≠ L^{L'}×M^{M'}. The correct formula involves π0(L') and π0(M').

Both statements are true when L', M' are connected presheaves (colimit = singleton), e.g. when one factor is the terminal presheaf. The next page appears to use only such cases (a⊠e_B), so the error may be harmless downstream.

ideas.what: Presheaves on A×B as functors on (A^)°×(B^)° that are continuous in each variable separately (universal property of free cocompletion)
ideas.modern_name: Free cocompletion; PSh(A×B) ≃ PSh(A) ⊗ PSh(B) (tensor product of cocomplete / locally presentable categories)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Kan / Yoneda (free cocompletion); Kelly and others (tensor product of cocomplete categories)
ideas.where_published: Universal property of presheaf categories is used in SGA4 Exp. I; similar manipulations appear in Pursuing Stacks

ideas.what: External product L⊠M = pr_A^*L × pr_B^*M and its pairing X(L,M) = Hom(L⊠M, X)
Claimed full faithfulness of ⊠ and internal-Hom formula Hom(L'⊠M', L⊠M) ≃ Hom(L',L)⊠Hom(M',M)
ideas.modern_name: none (false as stated; true for connected L', M')

deep.surprise_reason: Routine presheaf bookkeeping toward a model-structure computation on A×B. The main proposition and corollary are actually false in general, owing to a separate-vs-joint cocontinuity confusion, though they hold in the connected or terminal cases likely used next. Nothing new for the literature.
transcription_corrections: The margin note likely reads 'le signe !! a le sens analogue pour chacune des variables séparément'.
'L⊠M = p_B^*(L)⊠p_A^*(M)' is as written in the manuscript, but the intended meaning is pr_A^*(L) × pr_B^*(M). The projection subscripts are idiosyncratic or swapped.
The upper-right correction over (A×B)^ reads (A^×B^)^, i.e. the target is rewritten as presheaves on A^×B^.
In the corollary's proof, the right column reads Hom_A(a, Hom(L',L)) × Hom_B(b, Hom(M',M)) = Hom_A(a×L', L) × Hom_B(b×M', M), followed by 'ok'.
